meta.description: Gufasha gufata ibyemezo ku iterambere ry'abana bato mu Rwanda. AI itanga inama, abantu bafata ibyemezo.

provenance.simulatedExplain: Imibare imwe kuri iyi paji ni iy'igerageza. Si imibare nyayo.

originExplain.official: yatangajwe n'ikigo cya Leta nka NISR.
originExplain.partner: yatanzwe n'umufatanyabikorwa nka NCDA cyangwa n'irerero.
originExplain.simulated: yakozwe ku bw'igerageza. Si umubare nyawo.

impact.highRisk: Muri bo, abafite ibyago byo kugwingira
impact.mothers: Ababyeyi b'abana bari munsi y'imyaka 3 bavuga ko kurera bibabuza gukora
impact.countableOnly: Ibishobora kubarwa gusa. Iyi mibare ibara abana n'ababyeyi bagezweho; ntiteganya impinduka ku igwingira.

decision.rejectEffect: Igikorwa gikurikira kizabyitaho. Icyemezo cyawe kibikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura.

map.hatchLegend: Imirongo: igereranya rifite intera nini. Uko ari myinshi ni ko gushidikanya kwiyongera.
map.findLabel: Ikarita y'amarerero yagenzuwe: {count} agaragara. Urutonde ruri hasi rufite amarerero amwe.

design.title: Uburyo bw'imiterere
design.lead: Amabara ya Imigongo n'ibice by'ingenzi, byerekanwa n'imibare y'urugero. Ku bakora porogaramu gusa.
design.sample: Imibare iri kuri iyi paji ni iy'urugero.

footer.honesty: Ukuri ku makuru: muri iri gerageza buri irerero, raporo n'igereranya ni iby'igerageza kandi byanditsweho. Imbibi z'uturere n'imirenge ni zo makuru nyayo rusange gusa.
footer.layer: IrereroAI yakozwe nk'urwego rwiyongera ku buryo bwa NCDA bwo gushushanya amarerero, si iyo kubusimbura.
footer.methodology: Reba neza ibiri ukuri n'ibiri igerageza
footer.hackathon: NISR 2026 Big Data Hackathon, icyiciro cya 3

landing.title: Buri mwana muto agere ku irerero ryiza riri hafi
landing.lead: IrereroAI ifasha uturere gutegura aho amarerero akenewe, ifasha amarerero gutanga raporo mu minota itatu, kandi ifasha ababyeyi kubona umwanya hafi. AI itanga inama. Abantu bafata ibyemezo.

enrolment.text: Abana bari mu mashuri y'incuke uyu munsi, n'intego y'igihugu ya 2029.

stunting.text: Intego y'igihugu ku igwingira ry'abana bari munsi y'imyaka 5 mu 2029.

gicumbi.text: Abana bari munsi y'imyaka 5 bagwingiye i Gicumbi, akarere k'igerageza.

cycle.caption: Uruziga rumwe: ibyo amarerero atangaza n'ibyo ababyeyi basaba binoza igenamigambi rikurikira.

plan.title: Tegura
plan.text: Shyira ku rutonde aho kubaka, kuzamura cyangwa gushyigikira amarerero mu ngengo y'imari.

track.title: Kurikirana
track.text: Amarerero yohereza imibare icumi buri cyumweru; abakozi b'imirenge babona iburira n'impamvu.

find.title: Shaka
find.text: Ababyeyi babona amarerero yagenzuwe. Gushakisha kutagize icyo kubona bibarwa nk'icyifuzo kitarasubizwa.

learn.title: Iga
learn.text: Raporo, ibyifuzo n'ibyemezo byose, harimo ibyanzwe, bihindura inama zikurikira.

landing.promiseTitle: AI itanga inama, abantu bafata ibyemezo

promise.suggests: Buri gisubizo ni inama, si icyemezo.
promise.reasons: Buri nama yerekana impamvu zayo, intera n'amakuru yakoreshejwe.
promise.reject: Abategura bemeza, bahindura cyangwa banga; kwanga bisaba impamvu, kandi iyo mpamvu ihindura igenamigambi rikurikira.
promise.audit: Buri cyemezo cyandikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura kidashobora guhindurwa.
promise.nothingAutomatic: Nta kintu gikorwa mu buryo bwikora.

honesty.simulated: Iri ni igerageza. Amarerero, raporo za buri cyumweru, imibare y'abana n'igereranya ni iby'igerageza by'i Gicumbi kandi byanditsweho "amakuru y'igerageza" aho bigaragara hose.
honesty.real: Imbibi z'uturere n'imirenge ni amakuru nyayo rusange (NISR binyuze kuri geoBoundaries). Umubare w'igwingira i Gicumbi ni uwatangajwe na RDHS 2025; imibare y'imirenge iwukikije ni iy'igerageza.
honesty.phase2: Icyiciro cya 2 kizashyira ibarura rusange, EICV7, DHS, ubushakashatsi ku murimo, imibare y'uburezi n'urutonde rwa NCDA muri izi nzego zimwe.
honesty.privacy: Nta mazina, amafoto cyangwa nimero by'abana bikusanywa. Aho ababyeyi bari hazengurutswa kuri kare ya metero 500.

parents.title: Ababyeyi
parents.text: Shaka irerero ryagenzuwe riri hafi, n'amafaranga, amasaha n'imyanya iboneka.

caregivers.title: Abarezi
caregivers.text: Ohereza raporo y'icyumweru mu minota itatu, n'iyo nta murandasi cyangwa ukoresheje SMS.

officers.title: Abakozi b'imirenge
officers.text: Reba amarerero akeneye ubufasha iki cyumweru n'impamvu.

planners.title: Abategura n'abasesenguzi
planners.text: Gereranya igenamigambi mu ngengo y'imari, n'intera zivugisha ukuri.

landing.ncda: IrereroAI yakozwe kugira ngo yubakire ku buryo bwa NCDA bwo gushushanya amarerero n'igitabo cy'irerero cyashyizwe mu ikoranabuhanga, si ukubisimbura.

methodology.title: Uko bikora
methodology.lead: Uko amakuru akoreshwa kuva ku masoko kugeza ku cyemezo umuntu afata, n'ibiri ukuri uyu munsi n'ibiri igerageza.

sources.title: Amasoko
sources.what: Imibare ya Leta, amakarita rusange n'urutonde rw'abafatanyabikorwa.
sources.today: Imbibi nyazo; ibindi byose ni igerageza ry'i Gicumbi.
sources.phase2: Ibarura rusange 2022, EICV7, DHS 2025, LFS 2025, igitabo cy'imibare y'uburezi, urutonde rwa NCDA, WorldPop, OpenStreetMap.

alignment.title: Guhuza
alignment.what: Buri soko rihuzwa n'imirenge, n'umwaka waryo, inkomoko n'igenzura.
alignment.today: Porogaramu y'igerageza yandika imbonerahamwe zimwe ifite inkomoko = igerageza.
alignment.phase2: Uburyo bumwe kuri buri soko, n'igenzura rigomba gutsinda mbere yo kwinjiza amakuru.

models.title: Imiterere y'imibare
models.what: Ibikenewe kuri buri murenge n'intera, ahagerwa n'amaguru, n'iburira hakiri kare.
models.today: Uburyo bworoshye busobanurwa: igereranya ryabitswe, intera y'umurongo ugororotse, amategeko agereranya buri rerero n'amateka yaryo.
models.phase2: Igereranya ry'uduce duto rihuzwa n'imibare ya Leta, igihe cyo kugenda n'amaguru, no kubona ibidasanzwe.

suggestions.title: Inama
suggestions.what: Urutonde rugufi mu ngengo y'imari, n'impamvu, intera n'amasoko.
suggestions.today: Guhitamo intambwe ku yindi hakurikijwe uburemere mwahisemo; bigereranywa n'igipimo cy'abaturage benshi mbere.
suggestions.phase2: Uburyo nyabwo bwo gushaka igisubizo cyiza inyuma ya paji imwe.

decision.title: Icyemezo cy'umuntu
decision.what: Emeza, hindura cyangwa wange. Kwanga bisaba impamvu.
decision.today: Birakora byuzuye, n'igitabo cy'igenzura kidashobora guhindurwa.
decision.phase2: Nta gihinduka: abantu ni bo bafata ibyemezo buri gihe.

feedback.title: Kwiga
feedback.what: Raporo za buri cyumweru, ibyifuzo by'ababyeyi n'impamvu zo kwanga bihindura inama zikurikira.
feedback.today: Ibyanzwe biba imbogamizi; ibyifuzo by'ababyeyi bizamura agaciro k'ahantu; raporo zitera iburira.
feedback.phase2: Imiterere y'imibare yongera kwigishwa hakurikijwe ibyemezo na raporo.

methodology.sourcesTitle: Amasoko y'amakuru n'aho ageze uyu munsi

signIn.title: Injira
signIn.lead: Ni iy'abategura b'uturere. Ababyeyi bashobora gusaba irerero nta konti.
signIn.failed: Ibyo watanze ntibihuye. Bigenzure wongere ugerageze.
signIn.demoLead: Bigaragara mu igerageza gusa. Utegura w'igerageza wa Gicumbi, ku makuru y'igerageza.
signIn.parentsNote: Ababyeyi ntibakenera konti: koresha Saba irerero.

needMap.title: Ikarita y'ibikenewe
needMap.lead: Ibikenewe kuri buri murenge n'intera zivugisha ukuri. Imirenge isizwe imirongo ni yo igereranya ryayo ritizewe cyane.
needMap.pickHint: Hitamo umurenge ku ikarita cyangwa mu mbonerahamwe.

plan.title: Igenamigambi
plan.lead: Shyiraho ingengo y'imari n'ibyihutirwa. Uhabwa urutonde rugufi rw'inama. Nta kintu gikorwa utabyemeje.

weightHelp.stunting: Abana bo mu mirenge ifite ibyago byinshi bahabwa agaciro karenze.
weightHelp.readiness: Abana bafite imyaka 3 kugeza 6 bahabwa agaciro karenze.
weightHelp.jobs: Abana bari munsi y'imyaka 3 bafite ababyeyi bavuga ko kurera bibabuza gukora bahabwa agaciro karenze.

plan.policyNote: Ubu buremere ni icyemezo cya politiki, si icya tekiniki. Mubyumvikaneho n'akarere mbere yo kwishingikiriza ku gisubizo.
plan.name: Izina ry'igenamigambi
plan.runNote: Inama zirabikwa. Ahanzwe hakomeza gukurwa mu igenamigambi rikurikira.
plan.emptyText: Shyiraho ingengo y'imari n'ubuterere, hanyuma usabe inama.
plan.baselineNote: Kugereranya: kubaka aho abana benshi batuye (hatitawe ku myanya ihari n'ubuterere) byagera ku bana {reached}, muri bo {risk} bafite ibyago byo kugwingira, ku ngengo y'imari imwe.
plan.smallNote: Gushyigikira ireme ry'amarerero ariho. Abakozi b'imirenge na bo bashobora kubifataho icyemezo.
plan.methodText: Buri cyiciro gihitamo igikorwa gifite inyungu nyinshi ku ifaranga kandi kigikwiye mu ngengo y'imari, hakabarwa abana bari mu rugendo rw'iminota {minutes} n'amaguru batarabona umwanya. Ahanzwe hakurwamo, ahagoye kugera hakabarwa igice. Uburyo: {version}. Icyiciro cya 2 kizabusimbuza uburyo nyabwo bwo gushaka igisubizo cyiza.

whatIf.title: Bigenze bite
whatIf.lead: Gereranya ingengo y'imari n'ubuterere bigera kuri bitatu. Nta kibikwa.
whatIf.baselineExplain: Yubaka aho abana benshi batuye, hatitawe ku myanya ihari n'ubuterere, ku ngengo y'imari y'amahitamo ya 1.

decisionsLog.title: Ibyemezo
decisionsLog.lead: Buri cyemezo, impinduka n'icyanzwe muri aka karere, ibishya mbere.
decisionsLog.auditNote: Ibi bituruka ku nyandiko z'ibyemezo; igitabo cy'igenzura kibika amateka amwe kandi ntigishobora guhindurwa.

brief.noPlan: Banza ukore igenamigambi kugira ngo ubone raporo.
brief.title: {district}: igenamigambi ry'iterambere ry'abana bato
brief.humans: Buri gikorwa kiri hano cyemejwe n'umuntu. IrereroAI yatanze inama gusa.

national.title: Incamake y'igihugu
national.lead: Uturere 30 twose ku rwego rw'akarere, n'intera. Amakuru y'imirenge n'igenamigambi biboneka ku karere kawe.
national.tableCaption: Imibare n'intera. Uturere dusizwe imirongo ku ikarita ni two dufite intera nini.
national.note: CSV itanga imibare y'uturere gusa; imibare iri munsi ya 5 yandikwa <5 kandi buri murongo ugaragaza inkomoko yawo.

tour.title: Urugendo rw'iminota itanu
tour.lead: Urugendo ruyobowe muri iki kiganiro. Buri ntambwe ifungura urupapuro rukwiye, ikinjira nk'utegura w'igerageza igihe bikenewe, kandi ikerekana icyo kureba. Rukoresha amakuru y'igerageza gusa.
tour.label: Urugendo ruyobowe
tour.offline: Urugendo ntirukenera murandasi: buri ntambwe ikoresha ububiko bw'igerageza buri hano. Niba ikarita fatizo idafunguka, amakarita yerekana imbibi gusa.

welcome.title: Ikibazo
welcome.text: Abana bari mu mashuri y'incuke bagomba kwikuba hafi kabiri bitarenze 2029, kandi igwingira i Gicumbi rigeze kuri 38.8%. Uturere tugomba guhitamo aho gushora imari, amakuru adahwanye.
welcome.say: Vuga: ikarita yerekana ibihari. IrereroAI yerekana igikurikiraho.

needMap.title: Ibikenewe, n'intera zivugisha ukuri
needMap.text: Imirenge ya Gicumbi isize amabara hakurikijwe ibikenewe. Imirenge isizwe imirongo ni yo igereranya ryayo ritizewe cyane. Utudomo dutukura ni amarerero yuzuye cyane cyangwa adafite amazi; uruziga ni ibyifuzo by'ababyeyi.
needMap.say: Vuga: twerekana gushidikanya aho kuguhisha. Byose hano byanditseho ko ari igerageza.

reject.title: Inama, hanyuma icyemezo
reject.text: Kanda "Habwa inama". Ahantu ha Cyumba A haza imbere kuko ababyeyi basabye irerero aho. Hange ukoresheje "Nta butaka buhari" urebe urutonde rwuzurwa hatarimo.
reject.say: Vuga: impamvu yo kwanga iba itegeko ku igenamigambi ryose rikurikira, kandi iri mu gitabo cy'igenzura.

whatIf.title: Igenamigambi ryacu ugereranyije n'umubare w'abaturage gusa
whatIf.text: Gereranya ingengo y'imari n'uburemere bigera kuri bitatu no gushyira amarerero aho abana benshi batuye. Igenamigambi rigera ku bana benshi bafite ibyago ku mafaranga amwe.
whatIf.say: Vuga: aba ni abana n'ababyeyi bagerwaho, si igabanuka ry'igwingira riteganyijwe.

parent.title: Umubyeyi asaba irerero
parent.text: I Cyumba irerero riri hafi riri kure n'amaguru. Kanda "Saba irerero hano". Habikwa kare ya metero 500 gusa, nta zina cyangwa nimero ya telefone.
parent.say: Vuga: ibyifuzo bigaragara ku ikarita y'utegura kandi byongera agaciro k'ahantu hari hafi yabyo.

promise.title: Isezerano ryacu
promise.text: AI itanga inama, abantu bafata ibyemezo. Buri nama ifite impamvu, intera n'amasoko yayo; nta kintu gikorwa mu buryo bwikora; kandi buri mubare uri kuri ecran uvuga niba ari ukuri cyangwa igerageza.
promise.say: Vuga: icyiciro cya 2 kizashyira amakuru nyayo y'ibarura rusange, DHS, EICV na NCDA muri izi nzego zimwe.

request.mapHint: Cyangwa kanda ku ikarita uhitemo ahantu.
request.privacy: Habikwa kare ya metero 500 ikikije aho hantu gusa. Nta zina, nimero ya telefone cyangwa konti bikenewe.
request.title: Saba irerero hano
request.lead: Reba amarerero yagenzuwe ari hafi, hanyuma usabe irindi riri hafi kurushaho. Icyifuzo cyawe kigaragara ku ikarita y'utegura w'akarere; aho uri neza ntihabikwa.
request.pickFirst: Hitamo umurenge cyangwa ukande ku ikarita urebe amarerero ari hafi.
request.noneNearby: Nta rerero ryagenzuwe ryanditswe hafi y'aha.
request.askLead: Icyifuzo cyawe kibarwa nk'akadomo ku ikarita y'igenamigambi ry'akarere, iruhande rw'ibyifuzo by'abandi babyeyi.
request.requested: Murakoze. Icyifuzo cyanyu cyabaruwe ku gace ka {sector}.
